auth_gs_intro: Codehood courses are written locally and synced with a CLI tool. Four steps to your first push.
auth_gs_step2_body: Questions, exams, and resources live as plain text files under {code} and edit them in whatever editor you already use.
auth_gs_step3_body: The CLI authenticates as you with a key. Generate one below, or manage keys any time from your profile.

auth_home_title: Codehood: run your course like a Git repo
auth_home_eyebrow: A learning management system for programmers
auth_home_headline: Run your course like a Git repo.
auth_home_lead: Write questions, exams and resources as plain text files instead of clicking through web forms. Edit locally, push when you're ready, and your students see it in their browser.
auth_home_step1_body: creates a course folder with a config file and directories for questions, exams, the calendar and resources. Plain text, yours to version.
auth_home_step2_body: Questions, exams and resources are files you write in the editor and workflow you already use. No forms, no lock-in.
auth_home_step3_body: syncs your changes to the server. Students see them in the browser right away, with no separate publish step.
auth_home_feature1_title: Your course is a Git repository
auth_home_feature1_body: Questions, exams and resources are plain text files on your machine. Diff them, branch them, review them like code. Nothing is locked in a database you can't export.
auth_home_feature2_body: Multiple choice and short answer today, more on the way. A question lives in your course, ready to reuse in the next exam or the next semester.
auth_home_students_lead: No CLI required. Students check the calendar, take exams and work through the questions their instructor published, like in any web-based LMS. The CLI is there if they want it.
auth_home_students_next_title: A home that says what's next
auth_home_students_next_body: What's open now, what's coming this week and what was graded.
auth_home_students_exams_body: Answers save as they change, with the time left always in view.
auth_home_demo_instructor: Ada Lovelace · you take this course
auth_home_why_heading: Built for how you already work.
auth_home_join_body: Codehood is invite-only for now. Type the code your instructor shows in class, or log in if you already have an account.
